ns0:problem.ns0:para: Determine whether each graph is the graph of a function.

ns0:media.alt: The figure has two graphs. In graph a there is an ellipse graphed on the x y-coordinate plane. The x-axis runs from negative 6 to 6. The y-axis runs from negative 6 to 6. The ellipse goes through the points (0, negative 3), (negative 2, 0), (2, 0), and (0, 3). In graph b there is a straight line graphed on the x y-coordinate plane. The x-axis runs from negative 12 to 12. The y-axis runs from negative 12 to 12. The line goes through the points (0, negative 2), (2, 0), and (4, 2).
